notes.title: [ISSUE FIXED NOW] Installation Instructions - Play Now not visible on steam
notes.content:
ISSUE IS FIXED NOW YOU

Important Update for "Resurrection: Nuke Island" Players

We’re aware of an issue affecting the visibility of the "Play Now" button on our Steam store page. As a temporary workaround, you can add the game to your library using the following method:

1. Open the Run dialog on your computer by pressing Win + R.
2. Enter the following command: steam://install/2825030
3. Press Enter.
This will add "Resurrection: Nuke Island" to your Steam library so you can start playing immediately.

We are actively working with Steam support to resolve this issue and appreciate your patience. If you encounter any further problems or have questions, please let us know!

Thank you for your understanding and support.

notes.title: Operation Nuke Island: Scientists in Peril
notes.content:
In Resurrection: Nuke Island, the world stands on the brink of disaster. An alarming discovery is made when 8 scientists suddenly go missing from a high-profile virology conference. The CIA’s frantic investigation reveals an even darker twist: North Korean scientists are also missing, raising suspicions of a covert, dangerous operation.

With international tensions on the rise, the CIA deploys Roman, a battle-hardened special ops commando, to North Korea. His mission is clear: find the scientists, ensure their safety, and extract them before they are forced to contribute to a catastrophic plan. But time is short, and the threat of nuclear fallout looms large.

In this high-stakes mission, it’s not just the lives of the scientists at risk—global security is on the line. Will Roman succeed in averting disaster?

Prepare for intense action, strategic infiltration, and a race against time in this gripping new chapter of Resurrection: Nuke Island.
